user.title: WuyeBao (JHCloud)
user.description: Enter the phone number and password of your 物业宝(业主) app. The integration logs into the official server https://wuye.jhws.top/ directly — no packet capture needed.

community.title: Select community
community.description: This phone number is bound to multiple communities. Select the community whose gates you want to control.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The WuyeBao login expired or the password changed. Please re-enter your credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the server. Check your network and try again
error.invalid_auth: Login failed: wrong phone number or password
error.no_community: No community found for this phone number. Make sure the 物业宝 account is activated
error.unknown: Unknown error, see the Home Assistant log

abort.no_community: No community found for this phone number

init.title: WuyeBao options
init.description: Server and open-door details. Defaults come from the official app binary and usually need no changes. {gateId} is replaced with the gate id.
